description: This file defines the FindCursor class used for querying documents from a MongoDB collection. It includes methods for cursor manipulation, query options, and execution of find operations.

classes.name: FindCursor
classes.description: A cursor class for iterating over query results from a MongoDB collection with various query options and methods for cursor control.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the cursor with the same options and filter.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms the documents from the cursor with a provided function.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the cursor by executing the find operation against the server.

methods.name: getMore
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of documents from the cursor.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of documents matching the filter; deprecated.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Executes an explain command for the find operation with different verbosity options.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sets a new filter for the cursor.

methods.name: hint
methods.description: Sets a hint for the query to use a specific index.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Sets the minimum index boundary for the cursor.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Sets the maximum index boundary for the cursor.

methods.name: returnKey
methods.description: Modifies the output to only include index keys.

methods.name: showRecordId
methods.description: Includes internal record id in the results.

methods.name: addQueryModifier
methods.description: Adds or modifies query modifiers such as $comment, $explain, etc.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Attaches a comment to the query for logging or debugging purposes.

methods.name: maxAwaitTimeMS
methods.description: Sets a maximum await time for tailable cursors.

methods.name: maxTimeMS
methods.description: Sets a maximum execution time for the query.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Adds a projection stage to specify which fields to return.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the query results.

methods.name: allowDiskUse
methods.description: Allows disk usage for sorting operations.

methods.name: collation
methods.description: Sets collation options for string comparison.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of documents to return.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips the specified number of documents.

ctags.name: response
ctags.pattern: /^    const response = await executeOperation(this.client, findOperation, this.timeoutContext);$/
